adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the diff adds `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` and then calls `usernames.split(",")`. Rails parameters can be submitted as an Array/Hash (e.g., `usernames[]=a&usernames[]=b`), in which case `params.require(:usernames)` would return an Array/Hash and `.split` would raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500. The diff does not coerce/validate `usernames` to a String before splitting.
